summary: Test tiers: a tier definition, a CI_TEST_TIER filter in ci-nextest (default all, nothing selects a tier yet) and the inventory proof extended to prove the tiers disjoint and complete

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes CI test selection scripts and docs.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. CI_TEST_TIER defaults to all, so every existing caller selects exactly the tests it selected before.

recovery.detail: No recovery procedure; reverting restores the previous selection scripts.
